urban_erosion: UMRI_growth(2100) - UMRI_fixed2025(2100) < 0; monotonic normalization makes this equivalent to S_growth < S_fixed2025
primary_area_estimand: Area of reference cells whose within-cell 15-member median state or paired difference is negative
uncertainty_companion: Negative area computed separately within each member; report its 17th, 50th and 83rd percentiles
primary_denominator: All fixed historical reference cells, 934814; invalid or unknown cells remain separately recorded
secondary_denominator: Valid evaluated reference cells for the named support
spatial_semantics: Area of disjoint central reference grid cells classified by the 500 m neighbourhood index. Do not sum overlapping neighbourhood areas; this is not surviving mangrove area in 2100.
numerical_semantics: Strict signs from archived float32 S. State normalization is monotone; pair each member before taking pixelwise medians. Exact stored ties are retained as zero, separate from missing.
title: Endpoint evidence at 2100
support: Common forecast support, with matched2025 as a companion
zero_semantics: Zero means equality at archived float32 score precision. Member effects may differ even where their pixelwise median is zero. Missing cells remain unknown.
native_habitat: Spatially average m and C within each branch using valid-centre counts, subtract branches within the same member, multiply by 100 for percentage points, then compute ensemble quantiles.
avoided_urban_loss: For each overall paired member at 2100, 100*(UMRI_protected-UMRI_growth)/(UMRI_fixed2025-UMRI_growth); quantiles are taken after computing this ratio. The fraction is relative to additional urban loss, not the total resilience deficit.
